build_qasrl_data: build the QA-SRL dataset by calling the build function with an opt dictionary
create_qasrl_teacher: create a QASRLTeacher instance with an opt dict to load QA-SRL dialog data
setup_qasrl_data: setup QA-SRL data by parsing wiki1 train dev or test files into question answer pairs
parse_qa_pairs: parse raw QA-SRL data lines into question and answer pairs using the convert_to_qa helper
get_qasrl_data_path: get the QA-SRL data file path for train valid or test splits using the _path function
